newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian Central Bank offers 500 mln pound repo.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian Central Bank offers 500 mln pound repo.

text.p: The Central Bank of Egypt has offered banks a two-week repurchase of treasury bills worth 500 million pounds, bankers said on Thursday.
Banks that want to lend any outstanding bills back to the central bank for the two-week period must put in bids by 10 a.m. local time on Tuesday, October 1, they said.
The central bank will take the bids at the highest rates and announce the allocations later that day, they added.
The aim is to make it easier for banks to subscribe to the treasury's seven-year bonds, the bankers said.

The last day for applications for the 11-percent bonds is Monday, September 30. But banks might be able to borrow short-term from public-sector banks knowing the repurchase offer will ease liquidity the next day.
The repurchase offer applies to any outstanding treasury bills, either 91-days or 182-days.
The bankers described the amount on offer as fairly small. Outstanding bills are worth a total of 28 billion pounds.
